catches: Referrer: existing customer with an active account at The Bank of Princeton.
Referrer earns $50, credited to an existing personal checking or savings account; max $500 in one year (10 referrals).
Friend (referee): must open a NEW Wise Checking account (new money only), deposit at least $50 at opening, and have a new $500+ payroll/Social Security direct deposit within 60 days of opening.
Referral form must be presented at account opening.
Friend's $125 bonus deposited within 30 business days after the initial $500+ direct deposit posts.
If the Wise Checking account is closed within 6 months, the bank may reclaim the bonus.
Limit 1 Wise Checking account per Tax ID; new consumer accounts only; offer on new money only.

steps: Complete the Bank of Princeton Refer-A-Friend referral form with your information.
Friend presents the slip when opening a new Wise Checking account with at least $50.
Friend sets up a new $500+ payroll or Social Security direct deposit within 60 days.
timing: Paid after all promotion requirements are met.
when_cash_arrives: Paid after all promotion requirements are met. Paid after your friend completes the program's activity requirements - the friend's qualification is the gating step.
maximize: Have your friend knock out transaction counts in a single day (small purchases) and set up direct deposit on the first paycheck - do not let activity dribble across the window.
Verify the exact qualification checklist with the institution before referring - thin-terms programs often have unpublished requirements that void referrals.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: you only get paid if the friend completes real banking activity; a join-and-idle referral earns nothing.
